reviews.text:
Austin hires these youths from the “troubled youth program”, they in turn destroy your filter system on purpose. Then he claims to provide an underwater diver who will detect problem for $600, plus $1800 to fix it!

I had an independent contractor fix the pump for $172!! The actual issue is that his OG crew reversed the pump! Entire pump area has water damage!

Stay away from this company!!!
reviews.author: Sarvi D

reviews.text: Its honestly been a blessing coming accross Austin and his team to fix my pool!!! It's seemed like no one could fix my pool at a reasonable price and timeline 2 days! 2 days is all it took to have my pool sparkling. I would recommend them to anyone i know! So professional and knowledgeable im thankful to have found them! Highly recommend!
reviews.author: INEZ OH9 OH8

reviews.text: Had repairs done to pool pump and lighting. His price was very fair compared with others. Austin was prompt and provided excellent communication throughout the process.
reviews.author: Amanda Quam

reviews.text: We cannot recommend Simply Clean Pools enough. They are reliable, and detail oriented. Austin and his team do amazing, thorough work keeping our pool looking great. Their customer service has been outstanding. Any question I have, Austin is quick to answer. An added bonus is that they do more than just clean your pool. If you need any kind of repair done, they can do it! It’s like a one-stop shop, and takes the guess work out of everything. They just replaced our pool light, did a small repair and installed a heater for our pool, all in one day! And the heater will not make our bill skyrocket, and can allow my kids to swim at least 9 months out of the year. We are so grateful. Austin does the research, and shows me the comparison between different products and prices, so I know I’m making the best choice for our pool and our needs. I love that Simply Clean Pools does it ALL! Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Katy Cutlip

reviews.text: I have had various pool service providers for a period of 20 years.  Simple Clean Pools is the BEST service I have experienced.  The pool is consistently crystal clear!  Each week shortly after the service;I receive an email with a status update letting me know the details of activity/chemicals added.. Excellent customer service,  I rate them 10/10.
reviews.author: Sharon Ewing

reviews.text: Great service! I highly recommend Simply Clean Pools! They do the “little extras”, without charging extra. They are reliable and are good about communicating with you. I never have to worry about anything going wrong with my pool…and it looks great!
reviews.author: Kathy Madeira

reviews.text: Austin and his crew are awesome. I started out having him work on my rental and liked his team so much that I asked them to take care of my own pool as well. Excellent communication and very easy to work with. A+
reviews.author: Chris Wilczewski

reviews.text: As a first time home buyer, Austin provided great insight on what it meant to maintain a pool. The reassurance and clarity along with timely repairs was much appreciated. Thank you!
reviews.author: Kassandra Alcala

data.summary: The reviews present a highly conflicting story. While there are detailed, passionate 5-star reviews, there are also multiple, highly specific 1-star reviews alleging fraudulent behavior, taking deposits without work, and intentional damage. The significant rating discrepancy between the two Google listings and the nature of the scam allegations are major red flags. The positive reviews could be authentic, but the pattern of severe complaints suggests potential issues with business practices or review manipulation.
fake_signals: Extreme polarity in reviews (all 5-star vs severe 1-star)
Specific, detailed scam allegations from multiple reviewers
Owner responses on HQ page defending against fraud claims
Lack of BBB or other third-party verification
Yelp search results show a 5/5 rating but no accessible review page for verification
authentic_signals: Specific details in negative reviews (names, programs, prices)
Owner responses present on HQ page
Some positive reviews mention specific services (light repair, heater installation)
data.discrepancy_explanation: Significant discrepancy between Google Maps Local (4.9) and Google Maps HQ (4.4) ratings for the same business. The HQ page contains severe negative reviews alleging scams and non-performance, which are not proportionally reflected in the Local page's high average.
